properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Private DNS Zone: Must Be Linked to Hub VNet
properties.description: Audits Azure Private DNS Zones that are not linked to the hub virtual network. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7) to ensure DNS resolution for private endpoints and internal services occurs within the trusted network boundary. All Private DNS Zones must have a VNet link to the hub VNet for consistent name resolution across the hub-spoke topology.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance for Private DNS Zones without VNet link. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
